question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Tomato'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence mentions** that it was common for the poor of the area around Naples to add something to their yeast-based flatbread, which led to the beginning of pizza.
 
• The word **"tomato"** is the correct answer because it was the ingredient that was commonly added to the flatbread.
 
• The **use of tomato** as a topping on pizza is a key factor in its evolution and has become an integral part of traditional pizza recipes.
 
• Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *It was common for the poor of the area around Naples to add **tomato** to their yeast-based flat bread, and so the pizza began.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Option 2) "potato"** is not historically associated with the early development of pizza. While potatoes have their culinary uses, they are not typically used as a topping for traditional pizza.

**Option 3) "onion"** is also not the ingredient commonly added to the flatbread in the context of pizza's origin.

**Option 4) "herb" **is a more general term and does not specifically refer to the significant ingredient that led to the evolution of pizza.
